description: This file defines the 'Acknowledgements' interface in Java, representing an aggregate of acknowledgment objects with methods to access acknowledgment details, generate new acknowledgment instances, and serialize to JSON. It includes nested static classes defining JSON field schemas and provides factory methods for creation and management of acknowledgments within a larger system, particularly in context of the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: Acknowledgements.JsonFields
classes.description: Contains static definitions for JSON fields used in serializing/deserializing Acknowledgements instances.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type string of acknowledgements for a specific entity type.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new Acknowledgements instance from a collection of acknowledgements and headers.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new Acknowledgements instance with specified entity ID, acknowledgements, status code, and headers.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Generates an empty Acknowledgements instance for the given entity ID and headers.

methods.name: getResponseType
methods.description: Determines the response type based on contained acknowledgments success status.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Retrieves the overall HTTP status code representing the aggregate acknowledgment state.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns an optional JSON entity representing the acknowledgments, schema-dependent.

methods.name: getMissingAcknowledgementLabels
methods.description: Provides a set of acknowledgment labels that are missing.

methods.name: getSuccessfulAcknowledgements
methods.description: Provides a set of acknowledgements marked as successful.

methods.name: getFailedAcknowledgements
methods.description: Provides a set of acknowledgements marked as failed.

methods.name: getAcknowledgement
methods.description: Retrieves a specific acknowledgment by its label.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of acknowledgments contained.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if there are any acknowledgments.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Provides a sequential stream of all acknowledgments.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Returns a JSON object representing this acknowledgment collection, including non-hidden fields.

methods.name: getManifest
methods.description: Returns the manifest string for this acknowledgement instance.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the resource path, defaulting to empty.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the entity ID associated with these acknowledgments.
